stories.title: Nicaragua's President Ortega says there will be no more elections, extending his rule
stories.summary: Nicaragua's President Daniel Ortega declares "there won't be any more elections," cementing his grip on power and ending hopes for a democratic vote.

stories.title: Wildfire alert in the Western U.S. reaches its highest level
stories.summary: Wildfires have now scorched four million acres of land in the U.S. Federal fire managers say all of the country's resources are currently deployed to major fires.

stories.title: U.S. reports highest number of measles cases in 35 years
stories.summary: For the second year in a row, the U.S. has reported a record-breaking number of measles cases. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on Friday said the country has now confirmed 2,318 measles cases -- the highest case count since 1991.

stories.title: India's 'cockroach' movement ousts minister, but can Modi calm youth?
stories.summary: Led by Gen-Z youth across India, the movement has become perhaps the biggest challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi during his 12 years in office.

stories.title: Trump's relationship with the media on display at Correspondents' Dinner
stories.summary: President Trump is set to speak tonight at the rescheduled White House Correspondents dinner despite his difficult relationship with the press.

stories.title: Exploring the history of the telephone and how it reshaped the world
stories.summary: As part of NPR's 250th anniversary series America in Pursuit, we're taking a look back at one of America's most significant inventions: the telephone.
